```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

``` {r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(here)
library(skimr) #install.packages('skimr')
library(kableExtra) # install.packages('kableExtra')

### Read in data
lobsters <- read_xlsx(here("data/lobsters2.xlsx"),skip = 4)

#explore 
skimr::skim(lobsters)

sizeyear_summary <- lobsters %>%
  group_by(site, year) %>%
  summarize(count_by_year = n(),
            mean_size_mm = mean(size_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_size_mm = sd(size_mm, na.rm=TRUE)
            median_size_mm = median(size_mm, na.rm = TRUE),)

##'summarise()' regrouping output by 'site' (overrides with '.groups' arguement)
##'inspect our new variable
sizeyear_summary 

```

There are `r nrow(lobsters)` total lobsters included in this report.
Now there are `r count(lobsters)` total lobsters included in this report.

``` {r}

siteyear_summary<- lobsters  %>%
 group_by(site,year) %>%
  summarize(count_by_siteyear = n(),
            mean_size_mm = mean(size_mm,na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_size_mm = sd(size_mm,na.rm = TRUE),
            median_size_mm = median(size_mm, na.rm = TRUE))

##  summaries()  regrouping output by `site` (override with `groups` argument)

## a ggplot option
ggplot(data = siteyear_summary, aes(x=year, y = median_size_mm,color = site))+ geom_line()

ggsave(here("Figures","lobsters--line.png"))

# another option
ggplot(siteyear_summary, aes(x = year, y = median_size_mm)) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_wrap(~site)

ggsave(here("Figures","lobsters-col.png"))

## saving 7x5 in image
  

#lobsters %>%
  #mutate(size_m = size_mm / 1000)

lobsters_detailed <- lobsters %>%
  mutate(size_m = size_mm / 1000,
         millenia = 2000,
         observer = "Allison Horst")
  
  
```
